meta.title: Anti-Cheating homework sessions
meta.description: Start a protected homework session and receive a calm, evidence-based integrity report when your child finishes independent work.

hero.title: Homework without shortcuts.
hero.body: Start a protected homework session and let our system watch for unusual activity while your child works independently.
hero.note: If you're at work or away from home, you can still understand how the homework was completed.

watch.title: You don't have to sit beside them.
watch.body: You may be at work, driving, cooking, or simply giving your child space to work independently. Start an Anti-Cheating session and review the integrity report when they're finished.

steps.body: Pick the child, the assignment, and which signals to monitor.

steps.title: Our system monitors session activity

steps.title: Receive the integrity report
steps.body: A clear summary and timeline arrive as soon as the session ends.

capabilities.title: What the system can monitor
capabilities.body: Browsers can only see what happens inside the tab and window they run in. Signals below are labeled by what's actually running today versus what needs a future integration.
capabilities.boundaryNote: Signals marked “Live in your browser” run today, without a camera. Camera-based and network-level signals are being developed and will always require explicit, disclosed permission before they can activate.

items.title: Phone Detection
items.body: Detect possible phone usage during the homework session using on-device camera analysis.

items.title: Tab Switching
items.body: Record when the student leaves the homework page for another browser tab.

items.title: Window Switching
items.body: Identify when another application or browser window becomes active.

items.title: External Website Activity
items.body: Identify attempts to access unauthorized resources outside the homework page.

items.title: AI Tool Activity
items.body: Flag possible attempts to access AI assistants or related tools.

items.title: Copy / Paste Activity
items.body: Record suspicious copying or pasting within the homework page.

items.title: Student Presence
items.body: Detect whether the student appears to remain present during the session.

items.title: Multiple Person Detection
items.body: Flag situations where another person may enter the working area.

items.title: Session Timeline
items.body: Generate a timestamped timeline of every important event for parent review.

report.title: Homework Integrity Report
report.subject: Fractions Homework
report.summaryBody: Homework was completed with strong focus. One possible phone-use event was detected at 5:21 PM and the student returned to the assignment after approximately 14 seconds. Review recommended if this pattern continues.
report.disclaimer: This report summarizes detected session events. It is a review aid for parents, not proof of cheating.

integrityScore.heading: Integrity score
integrityScore.tooltip: Integrity Score is an indicator based on available session signals. It is not definitive proof of cheating.

privacy.title: Designed with student privacy in mind.
privacy.body: Anti-Cheating sessions are visible, not hidden. Every safeguard below is a default, not an option to configure away.
points: Parents knowingly start every monitoring session — there is no silent or background mode.
The student is informed on-screen when monitoring is active, before the session begins.
Camera-based signals are off by default and always require explicit browser permission.
Monitoring ends the moment the homework session ends — nothing continues in the background.
No hidden monitoring, and no attempt to activate camera or microphone without permission.
Reports capture useful events, not continuous recordings.
Session data is handled under 2tor's privacy policy, with the same protections as the rest of the platform.
